_about: Per-(model, store) surface conformance for malign_logits.twp_words. u2581_rate is the fraction of `word` values carrying the SentencePiece boundary marker; bytefall_rate the fraction that are raw <0xHH> tokens. Neither is derivable from rule_version, dict_sha, tokenizer_properties.json or edge_token_overlap.json -- see the module docstring. Flags are 10x the roster median (floor 0.01) and are descriptive, not a ruling.
